summary: RAS Poster Story integration passes all seven review targets: typecheck is 0 errors with a sound sharp re-export shim (not a blanket declare module); Anton is registered via the cwd-safe getFontsDir()+FONT_SPECS path as family 'Anton' weight 400 with no module-top-level cwd-relative read; renderRasPosterStoryTool exists, is registered in src/mastra/index.ts, renders <RasPosterStoryTemplate> via renderComponentToPng(RAS_CANVAS), and succeeds with no logo binary via the text wordmark fallback; the demo asserts a real PNG signature (81852 bytes) and Anton-present and exits 0; 'ras-poster-story' was not added to any external Design Agent template_id enum and a clarifying comment exists in design-tools.ts; render-chain imports use '.js' specifiers; and the existing ras:render:test story path still renders a correct 1080x1350 PNG. No blocker or major findings.

findings.detail: makeHeroCutout loads the ~140MB @imgly/background-removal-node model for any non-already-transparent hero source. This is skipped by the demo (synthetic transparent hero) and acceptable for the tool, but worth knowing before invoking on arbitrary cold input. Informational; no change required.

CHAR_EM = 0.44 is an approximate measured advance width for Anton used by the copy-fit heuristic; unusual letter mixes could still overflow the headline pill. Flagged by the author's own comment. Informational; no change required.
